title: Department of Education Announces 13th Essay Writing Competition for School Teachers and Students
author: Dawa Tsering
content:
Dharamshala: With the objective of promoting the exchange of ideas and experiences among teachers, while also nurturing students’ interest and enthusiasm for essay writing, the Department of Education, Central Tibetan Administration, is pleased to announce the 13th Annual Essay Writing Competition and invites eligible participants to take part.

For detailed information, please refer to theTibetan announcementbelow.
